slides.title: History Became A Science In The 19th Century
slides.text: History Became A Science In The 19th Century
slides.speech: Academic history did not exist until the 19th century, when scholars finally replaced ancient myths with rigorous scientific analysis. True historical research relies on primary and secondary sources, using strict source criticism to prove authenticity. Over time, schools of thought like positivism and Marxism completely changed how we interpret events. Originally, history only studied written records, leaving older eras to archaeology until the 20th century expanded its scope. Today, experts still debate whether history is a social science or a subjective humanity, proving that the past is static, but our interpretation of it is constantly evolving.
